decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (12449-05, 12449-08, Design and Access Statement, Wall Mounted Unit Technical Specification, High Efficiency Roundflow Cassette Technical Specification. Received: 05/04/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The rating level of noise emitted from fixed plant on the site, shall at all times be lower than the existing background noise level by 10dB. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The levels shall be determined according to BS4142:1997.
description: Erection of four satellite dishes and one tv aerial to the rear elevation and two air conditioning units to rear elevation at ground floor level
